premise: Squirrel hides her hazelnut behind her back so nobody asks for it, then sees Mouse is hungry and shares.
inspiration: The Selfish Giant (Wilde), made small and quick: a heart opens in one moment, and what is shared tastes better than what is kept.

en-US.title: Squirrel Shares Her Nut
en-US.text: Squirrel {squirrel:pulse} had found the biggest, shiniest hazelnut in the whole forest. {squirrel:live} She nibbled it, looked around to check that nobody was watching, hid it behind her back… and hugged it tight. Mine, she whispered. Raccoon {raccoon:hop} came by. [curious] What have you got there? Nothing! said Squirrel. {squirrel:tint #FFB3C6} Then Mouse {mouse:pulse} came by, very slowly. His tummy rumbled. [sad] I haven't found a single nut today, he said. Squirrel looked at Mouse. She looked at her hazelnut. It was very big. [softly] And Mouse was very small. So Squirrel {squirrel:sparkle} cracked it open, {sfx:crack} crack! into three pieces, and gave Mouse the biggest one. Raccoon {raccoon:hop x2} cheered. [happily] And do you know? That little piece was the best thing Squirrel had ever tasted. {mouse:hearts} {squirrel:hearts}

es-ES.title: Ardilla comparte su avellana
es-ES.text: Ardilla {squirrel:pulse} había encontrado la avellana más grande y brillante de todo el bosque. {squirrel:live} La mordisqueó, miró a su alrededor para comprobar que nadie la veía, la escondió detrás de la espalda… y la abrazó fuerte. Mía, susurró. Mapache {raccoon:hop} pasó por allí. [curious] ¿Qué tienes ahí? ¡Nada!, dijo Ardilla. {squirrel:tint #FFB3C6} Luego pasó Ratón {mouse:pulse}, muy despacito. Le sonaban las tripas. [sad] Hoy no he encontrado ni una avellana, dijo. Ardilla miró a Ratón. Miró su avellana. Era muy grande. [softly] Y Ratón era muy pequeño. Así que Ardilla {squirrel:sparkle} la abrió, {sfx:crack} ¡crac!, en tres trozos, y le dio a Ratón el más grande. Mapache {raccoon:hop x2} lo celebró. [happily] ¿Y sabéis qué? Aquel trocito fue lo más rico que Ardilla había probado nunca. {mouse:hearts} {squirrel:hearts}

crack.prompt: a single hazelnut shell cracking open, a crisp small crack
